# Spirit Magus Origins (Fire / Ice / Rock / Erosion summoner buffs)

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Skills affected:** Summon Fire Magus, Summon Frost Magus, Summon Rock Magus, Summon Erosion Magus
- **Mechanic tags:** minion, spirit-magus, buff, defense, recovery

## Derived / confirmed formula

Slotting each magus grants the SUMMONER its origin at the summon skill's level, parsed from the season data's per-level progression text and scaled by Origin Effect (1+inc)x(1+additional). Fire: +N flat Attack AND Spell Critical Strike Rating (58 L1 -> 115 L20 -> 175 L40). Ice: restores N% of Max Life AND Max Energy Shield per second (2.4 -> 3.825 L20 -> 5.23 L40). Rock: -N% additional Hit Damage taken (-5.2 -> -8.05 L20 -> -8.2 L40), clamped at -50% AFTER scaling. Erosion: -N% additional Damage Over Time taken (-6.3 -> -9.15 L20 -> -9.3 L40), clamped at -50% AFTER scaling. Same magus slotted twice does not stack; different magi stack.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped, unverified — magnitudes sourced from skill data text, not measured live. Recorded assumptions needing in-game checks: (1) Ice's Life half rides life_regen_inc and is therefore scaled by Life Regeneration Speed — unconfirmed; the ES half is NOT speed-scaled (no ES-regen speed stat exists). (2) The -50% caps on Rock/Erosion are applied AFTER Origin Effect scaling and the cap itself does not scale — unconfirmed. (3) Origin magnitude keys off the summon skill's slotted level (Thunder precedent), not its effective level with +level mods. (4) Same-magus-twice no-stack is assumed from buff semantics.

## Implementation (engine model)

engine/spirit_magus_origins.py (per-magus regex over progression Descript + shared EMIT_TABLE), compute.py scan (synthetic origin_of_* conditions carrying the parsed magnitudes), aggregator.py generalized emission block. Fire -> attack/spell_crit_rating_flat; Ice -> life_regen_inc + NEW energy_shield_regen_pct (recovery folds es_regen = pct x Max ES into net ES); Rock -> NEW hit_dmg_taken_additional (display pool); Erosion -> dot_dmg_taken_additional. Summoner-side only, independent of minion DPS modules. Surfaced in the Origin of Spirit Magus box (origin_summary payload).
